title: Innovative rhein and hydroxy fatty acid ester prodrugs for the treatment of chronic inflammation.
authors: Han, Lu; Zang, Tao; Li, Zhi-Peng; Deng, Yao; Liu, Jun-Qi; He, Ying-Xin; Li, Ting-Ting; Li, Si-Ting; Zhang, Zi-Ling; Liao, Xiao-Ping; Ren, Hao; Zhao, Dong-Hao; Sun, Jian
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大黄酸-羟基脂肪酸酯前药治疗慢性炎症，涉及TLR4蛋白的分子动力学模拟，但核心是药物化学与炎症治疗，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic inflammation is related to heart disease, diabetes, cancer, arthritis, and bowel diseases. The rhubarb-derived natural product rhein is highly effective at treating chronic inflammation. However, the gastrointestinal side effects and liver disorders of rhein have limited the long-term clinical application. Herein, we developed a series of rhein-hydroxy fatty acid prodrugs to alleviate the side effects of rhein while enhancing its therapeutic activity. PURPOSE: We developed a novel method to overcome the side effects of rhein and enhance its pharmacological activity. The aim was to synthesize rhein hydroxy fatty acid ester prodrugs that retain anti‑inflammatory activity and alleviate gastrointestinal side effects. METHODS: A series of rhein hydroxy fatty acid ester prodrugs were synthesized by linking rhein with hydroxy fatty acid. The chemical structure of these prodrugs was characterized by Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), hydrogen proton nuclear magnetic resonance ((1)H NMR), and high-resolution mass spectrum (HRMS). The cytotoxicity of rhein-hydroxy fatty acid ester prodrugs was evaluated using RAW 264.7 and Caco-2 cells. Additionally, in vitro anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-apoptotic effects were assessed. The targeted rhein-hydroxy fatty acid ester prodrug was verified using the DSS-induced mouse colitis model. RESULTS: In vitro studies demonstrate that the target compound R-15HA is markedly superior to both the free drug and diacerein in mitigating inflammation, oxidative damage, and apoptosis, while showing almost no cytotoxicity at final concentrations below 160 mumol.L(-)(1). Furthermore, Western blot analysis revealed that R-15HA inhibited the TLR4/NF-kappaB/MAPK more effectively than free rhein and 15-hydroxypentadecanoic acid. Molecular dynamics simulations demonstrated that the R-15HA compound exhibits a good binding capability with the TLR4 protein. Rhein can partially prevent weight loss, liver and spleen indices colon shortening, expression of proinflammatory cytokines, and epithelial damage, while rhein-hydroxy fatty acid prodrugs R-15HA have a more pronounced effect than rhein in dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced colitis. CONCLUSION: Overall, our novel rhein-hydroxy fatty acid ester prodrugs are promising candidates for chronic inflammation in clinical therapy. This study might reveal an avenue to develop rhein hydroxy fatty acid ester prodrugs with satisfactory pharmacological activity to resolve various inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 背景：慢性炎症与心脏病、糖尿病、癌症、关节炎和肠道疾病相关。源自大黄的天然产物大黄酸 (rhein) 在治疗慢性炎症方面效果显著。然而，大黄酸的胃肠道副作用和肝脏疾病限制了其长期临床应用。在此，我们开发了一系列大黄酸-羟基脂肪酸前药，以减轻大黄酸的副作用，同时增强其治疗活性。目的：我们开发了一种新方法，以克服大黄酸的副作用并增强其药理活性。目标是合成保留抗炎活性并减轻胃肠道副作用的大黄酸羟基脂肪酸酯前药。方法：通过将大黄酸与羟基脂肪酸连接，合成了一系列大黄酸羟基脂肪酸酯前药。这些前药的化学结构通过傅里叶变换红外光谱 (FTIR)、氢质子核磁共振 ((1)H NMR) 和高分辨质谱 (HRMS) 表征。使用RAW 264.7和Caco-2细胞评估了大黄酸-羟基脂肪酸酯前药的细胞毒性。此外，评估了体外抗炎、抗氧化和抗凋亡效果。使用DSS诱导的小鼠结肠炎模型验证了目标大黄酸-羟基脂肪酸酯前药。结果：体外研究表明，目标化合物R-15HA在减轻炎症、氧化损伤和凋亡方面显著优于游离药物和双醋瑞因，同时在最终浓度低于160 mumol.L(-)(1)时几乎无细胞毒性。此外，Western blot分析显示，R-15HA比游离大黄酸和15-羟基十五烷酸更有效地抑制TLR4/NF-kappaB/MAPK通路。分子动力学模拟表明，R-15HA化合物与TLR4蛋白表现出良好的结合能力。大黄酸可部分防止体重减轻、肝脏和脾脏指数、结肠缩短、促炎细胞因子表达和上皮损伤，而大黄酸-羟基脂肪酸前药R-15HA在葡聚糖硫酸钠 (DSS) 诱导的结肠炎中比大黄酸具有更显著的效果。结论：总体而言，我们新型的大黄酸-羟基脂肪酸酯前药是慢性炎症临床治疗的有前景候选药物。这项研究可能为开发具有满意药理活性的大黄酸羟基脂肪酸酯前药以解决各种炎症性疾病提供一条途径。
